notes.title: Announcing the Perspective-Changing Action RPG—Journey Record!
notes.content:
PLAYISM is proud to announce Journey Record, an action RPG developed by Kochi Create where you use Crystals and the Magic Eye Camera to change your perspective of the world... literally.

Please wishlist the game and look forward to more updates!
